method: Actual source, independently esbuild-bundled; paired endpoints use platform structuredClone and asynchronous microtask delivery. This is not a browser module-worker execution.
limitations: Browser and installed-package observations are separate owner artifacts.
Physical peak copies, worker heap, cross-host compatibility and latency are not inferred from this probe.

probes.name: protocol rejects invalid ranking, Unicode, mutation counts and code-bearing data
one corpus has hand-derived BM25 and mutation/statistical parity
native malformed-input codes match and public facade is bounded
hidden add-on caps are exact, normalized handshake identities
lost commit reply stays unknown and receipt establishes exact commit
transport delay counts against owner deadline before commit
raw live-mutation replay observation
replayed live mutation frame cannot replace authoritative first outcome
raw post-commit result-send failure observation
failed post-commit result delivery reports commit or explicit unknown
256 terminal receipts evict oldest without retrying
failed startup and external disposal release resources exactly once
raw reentrant signal registration observation
reentrant live signal registration preserves admission FIFO
